claimScope: Only this transport marker; not an app-server protocol version.

claim: Token cost constants are 64 plus string UTF-16 length times 2 or 16 for non-string values.
claimScope: Estimation parameters, not exact serialized/network byte counts.

claim: Frame generator emits start at sequence 0, token batches with increasing sequence, and a final end. String segment target is max(1,floor(batchTargetBytes/4)); batching may exceed target for a single token.
claimScope: Generator output only; depends on tokenizer and caller-supplied transferId/batchTargetBytes.

claim: Tokenizer supports null/undefined/numbers/booleans/strings, arrays, recognized chunked arrays, and enumerable object entries. It rejects functions/bigints/symbols and cyclic values on the active traversal path; repeated non-cyclic references are traversed again.
claimScope: Tokenized branch only; not all inline Electron structured-clone semantics. Unsupported object classes are not explicitly type rejected: their enumerable entries are traversed.

claim: Short strings/keys emit a single value/key token; long strings emit string-start, UTF-16 slice string-chunks, string-end.
claimScope: Tokenized string/key path; final assembler concatenates slices. Boundary slices may divide a surrogate pair.

claim: Batch cost is 64 plus string UTF-16 length times 2 or 16.
claimScope: Approximate per-token cost; not byte-exact framing size.

claim: Recognized chunked arrays are flattened by iterating each chunk.
claimScope: Recognition is delegated to imported o.w; does not apply to arbitrary objects with a chunks property.

claim: Defaults are inline threshold 4194304 and batch target 2097152.
claimScope: Defaults only; constructor options can override both.

claim: Per-target sender keeps ordinary and critical queues with at most one chunk transfer active. It advances only after an ack matches current target/transferId/sequence and the part is marked delivered. Nonchunked critical messages may bypass a noncritical transfer. Loading requeues an in-progress transfer; destroyed/unavailable targets clean up. Deliver errors optionally retry; cleanup clears queues, transfer and subscriptions.
claimScope: Complete sender class. No explicit missing-ack deadline is present in this class; absence of a timer elsewhere is not established. Ordering guarantees apply per target and reviewed queue path.

claim: Electron sender wrapper supplies retry delay 1000 ms.
claimScope: Delivery-error retry only, not an acknowledgement deadline.

claim: Electron wrapper sends frame or inline payload on original channel, uses webContents destruction/loading availability, listens destroyed/did-start-loading/did-stop-loading, and removes lifecycle listeners on cleanup.
claimScope: This Electron webContents integration; not browser/other-host transport implementations.

claim: Ack handler validates [transferId,sequence] as a string and integer tuple.
claimScope: Shape validation only; sender further checks current transfer and sequence.

claim: Main receives ack on imported g.pt channel only from trusted IPC events, parses the tuple, then acknowledges using event.sender as target.
claimScope: Trust predicate and g.pt channel resolution are supplied by surrounding setup; this function does not define origin trust itself.

claim: Preload frame recognizer checks marker, string transferId, safe-integer sequence and kind; chunk frames require an array of valid tokens.
claimScope: Recognition used to distinguish chunk frames before shared-object side effects. It does not reconstruct messages.

claim: Preload token validator recognizes container/key/value/string tokens and the primitive value shape. A value token without a value property is accepted.
claimScope: Structural shape only; logical token ordering is handled by renderer assembler.
Constant used by preload acknowledgeChunkedMessage.
Complete property function; no delivery Promise or retry provided by this API.

claim: Main host messages are dispatched to renderer as MessageEvent(message,{data:payload}). Recognized chunk frames skip the nonchunk shared-object cache/video-layout side effects.
claimScope: Complete listener callback. Final chunked shared-object handling, if needed, must be traced in renderer; preload does not apply cache side effects to assembled chunk messages.

claim: Renderer recognizes the same frame marker and token shapes as preload.
claimScope: Complete paired validators; logical ordering is delegated to receiver/assembler.

claim: Ack payload is only transferId and sequence.
claimScope: For validated/pending/complete frames.

claim: Start clears previous transfers and creates an assembler with nextSequence=start.sequence+1. Missing transfer or sequence mismatch deletes that transfer and returns pending with no ack. Valid chunk consumes tokens and yields ack. End deletes transfer, requires a complete value, and returns assembled message plus ack. Assembler rejects unmatched end/key placement/nested string chunks/missing string boundaries/incomplete or multiple roots. Object keys are assigned with Object.defineProperty.
claimScope: Complete lazy initializer containing both classes. No assembler exception recovery is present within these classes; behavior at upstream exception boundaries remains unverified.

claim: Window-message gate rejects foreign non-null source and incompatible same-window origin. Chunk receiver ack is sent before returning a completed typed message; pending transfers do not dispatch. Complete messages must be nonnull objects with string type.
claimScope: Complete function. Synthetic events with source=null are accepted, matching preload dispatch. Listener ownership/disposal and shared-buffer consumers need separate tracing.

claim: Chunked array representation is a class with chunks and length; o.w resolves to instance check ts.
claimScope: Static representation, not generic array-like values.

claim: o.w predicate resolves to ts(e), an instanceof $o test.
claimScope: Imported helper binding must be preserved or replaced with an equivalent explicit representation.

claim: o.T computes an estimated traversal size and compares it strictly greater than threshold. Strings count UTF-16 units times 2; primitive/object/key constants are counted; encountering a recognized chunked array makes the early-check estimate infinite.
claimScope: Complete estimate functions, not JSON byte measurement; source getter/proxy/enumeration side effects not runtime tested.

claim: Size traversal flattens recognized chunked-array chunks.
claimScope: Same special representation as tokenizer wG.

claim: o.C reads size from a WeakMap populated by cs. Sender can select a cached size on message/result/params before fallback traversal.
claimScope: Cache lookup only; callsites that populate this cache and their accuracy still require tracing.

claim: Export binding resolves imported helper used by sender.
claimScope: Static export getter mapping.

claim: Export binding resolves imported helper used by sender.
claimScope: Static export getter mapping.

claimScope: Static export getter mapping.

Startup loads interactive shell environment and Object.assign merges all returned vars into process.env; only initial CODEX_HOME is explicitly restored when CODEX_ELECTRON_USER_DATA_PATH was set.
Shell environment loader spawns a shell with baseline marker env; returns parsed environment.
On macOS/Linux shell selection prefers os.userInfo().shell; SHELL alone does not reliably redirect it. Fallback can try zsh/bash.
CLI child launch environment begins with spread process.env, keeps CODEX_HOME for ordinary local macOS host, and sets CODEX_CLI_PATH based on resolved runtime.
CODEX_APP_SERVER_FORCE_CLI=1 disables websocket URL routing from CODEX_APP_SERVER_WS_URL or host websocket_url.
Local daemon route requires USE_LOCAL_DAEMON=1 and FORCE_CLI!=1 and no explicit CLI path, plus other conditions.
CODEX_CLI_PATH is a real supported runtime override.
CODEX_ELECTRON_USER_DATA_PATH directly controls application userData path.
Explicit userData path controls macOS packaged single-instance lock policy.
Demo launcher creates separate Codex home and userData, and passes --user-data-dir; no dedicated anonymous/demo auth flag is present in this launch block.
Preauth Statsig network gate codex_desktop_secret_auth_storage can return features.secret_auth_storage=true for app-server config overrides.
App-server argv uses -c config overrides and app-server --analytics-default-enabled.
Child env sanitization removes selected Electron/crashpad variables; it is not an auth credential allowlist.
Binary includes login/auth/storage and Codex Auth keyring service strings; this supports capability, not the active login source.
Binary includes encrypted auth storage backend error text.
Symbol name identifies SecretsKeyringAuthStorage backend; runtime selection and namespace not proven.
Signed CLI binary includes keychain access group 2DC432GLL2.com.openai.codex.cli; this is signature metadata, not proof it read a credential.
Embedded sample config exposes file auth-store option; does not prove it suppresses migration in current build.
Native binary owns auth.json storage strings; this file was never opened by this investigation.

early-bootstrap 在网络初始化满足后加载 bootstrap
bootstrap 动态导入 main 后调用 runMainAppStartup
主 HTML 的 renderer module 入口
renderer 入口按序初始化 RPC 和 app-main
app-main 创建 React root 并渲染 app-initial 返回组件
renderer postMessage 通过 electronBridge.sendMessageFromView 转发
mcp-request 交给对应 host app-server connection，并支持 coalesce/priority/timeout/expiry
thread-prewarm-start 独立预热请求路径
mcp-request-abandon 通过 host connection 丢弃客户端请求
显式环境变量控制 userData
macOS packaged 显式 userData 启用 single-instance lock
CODEX_HOME 控制 Codex 数据根目录
chat/work composer mode 有持久化状态
Codex 与 chat/work 路由模式切换不等于字符串删除
chat/work effective mode 由账户能力、workOnly 与加载状态共同决定
main 维护 electron-persisted-atom-state 并向各窗口同步
客户端 app-server 最低版本常量为 0.141.0
另有 MessageChannel app-host RPC，统一消息 IPC 不是全部接口
